meta.title: OpenPit Risk Playground - The pre-trade gate, live
language.label: Language
theme.label: Color theme
hero.title: The pre-trade gate, live
hero.lead: Set your limits, send an order, and watch the gate reserve funds, settle a fill, and update session risk - all in your browser. A trader, script, or AI agent {{emphasis}} get past your limits. Not "shouldn't." Can't.
hero.browserNote: Orders, balances, and P&L run locally in your browser on {{openpit}} (WebAssembly).
hero.parityTitle: One WASM binary. Browser and Node.js.
hero.parityDetail: Run the same OpenPit engine on both sides. With matching built-in policies, state, market data, and event timing, identical orders produce identical verdicts - enabling local pre-checks before the server call.
hero.sourceNote: You can view the source code for this example {{sourceLink}}.
steps.label: How the playground works
order.title: Send an order
order.intro: Build an SPCX order, then send it through pre-trade, reserve, commit, and its immediate execution report.
scenario.title: Or try a scenario
limits.title: Your limits
limits.intro: Funds owns the balance and P&L state. The other limits still run before an order reaches the simulated venue.
limit.funds.label: Funds cash allocation
limit.funds.description: Sets the opening USD balance in Funds
limit.size.label: Max order size
limit.size.description: Biggest single order the gate will pass
limit.value.label: Max order value
limit.value.description: OpenPit reports the accepted order value after pre-trade
limit.rate.label: Max orders per minute
limit.rate.description: How fast orders may be sent
limit.loss.label: Max session loss
limit.loss.description: Halts the account once P&L falls below minus this, in USD
limit.invalid: Enter a positive whole number to apply this limit.
limit.invalidMax: Enter a positive whole number no greater than {{max}}.
limit.engineNote: OpenPit applies this limit during pre-trade.
gate.title: The gate decides
gate.intro: Every order is checked against {{limits}} before it reaches the simulated venue, then an execution report returns immediately with the fill.
gate.emptyTitle: Send an order to run the lifecycle
gate.emptyBody: The gate checks the order against {{limits}}, reserves Funds, commits the accepted order, then immediately applies its execution report.
verdict.reasonFilled: Pre-trade passed. Funds reserved the balance, committed the order, and settled the immediate execution report.
verdict.reasonFilledHalted: Pre-trade passed and settled the fill. Its execution report then pushed P&L past the loss limit and halted the account.
report.title: Execution report applied
checks.title: Checked against {{limits}}
check.detail.skip: The engine response contains no separate verdict for this check
check.detail.pnlHalted: pre-trade passed; the execution report then tripped the P&L axis
check.detail.pnlPassed: OpenPit reported P&L {{pnl}} against the -{{limit}} loss limit
check.detail.fundsSell: {{quantity}} SPCX shares are available before settlement
check.detail.fundsBuy: Funds accepted this order against its available balance
check.detail.value: OpenPit accepted the order against the {{limit}} value limit
check.detail.rate: OpenPit accepted this order under the {{rate}}/min rate limit
error.limits: Limits must be positive whole numbers; rate must be 60/min or less.
error.order: Quantity and limits must be positive whole numbers; price must be a positive decimal; rate must be 60/min or less.
error.lossScenario: The loss scenario could not open its SPCX position.
